meta.name: dag-library
meta.description: Store a dag definition once and re-run it in one or two lines, instead of pasting the full definition JSON into every eval cell. MUST USE whenever the user wants to save a DAG for reuse, run a previously saved/named DAG, schedule the same graph repeatedly (nightly/weekly audits, recurring multi-agent pipelines), or asks where to put a dag definition file. Triggers: dag library, save this dag, reuse a dag, run the saved dag, stored dag definition, recurring dag, nightly dag, dag 정의 저장, 저장된 dag 실행, dag 반복 실행, DAG 만들어두고 여러 번.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保存常用流程一次，以后按名一键重跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头有反复要跑的流程，想存一次就能复用。
copy.tagline_en: Save a workflow once, then rerun it anytime by name.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have workflows you run repeatedly and want to store them once.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以把 DAG 定义存成命名文件,之后用一两行代码重跑;每次运行自动加时间戳,避免覆盖旧结果,也支持固定后缀复用同一结果。
howto.when: 当用户想保存/复用已命名的 DAG、重复调度同一张图(如每日审计),或询问定义文件存放位置时触发。

say.text: 把这个 DAG 存成 nightly-audit,以后每天重跑一遍。
say.note: 会写入 .omo/dags 并试跑一次确认。

say.text: 运行已保存的 nightly-audit,后缀指定为 20260818。
say.note: key 会带上该后缀,可复用上次结果。

say.text: 我保存的 nightly-audit 定义文件该放哪个目录?
say.note: 会指到用户目录或项目下的 .omo/dags。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can save a DAG definition as a named file and re-run it in one or two lines. Each run gets a timestamped key so old results aren't overwritten; a fixed suffix can reuse the same result.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to save/reuse a named DAG, re-run the same graph on a schedule (e.g. daily audit), or asks where the definition file should live.

say_en.text: Save this DAG as nightly-audit and re-run it daily.
say_en.note: Writes it to .omo/dags and does one test run.

say_en.text: Run the saved nightly-audit with suffix 20260818.
say_en.note: The key gets that suffix, so the previous result is reused.

say_en.text: Where should my saved nightly-audit definition file go?
